replies.author: DaFrozenBlaze
replies.body:
Every time you open a crate using a key purchased from the shop you will receive one lottery ticket. Enter the ticket into the lottery by clicking on it while it is in your backpack.

 Simply type /redeem while you are on an Avicus server and the reward will be delivered instantly!
